items.title: 6. Average Kinetic Energy is Proportional to Temperature (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: 6. Average Kinetic Energy is Proportional to Temperature: a main subheading of 6.1 Assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 119-119.

blocks.text: Gas ke particles ki average kinetic energy gas ke absolute temperature (Kelvin temperature) ke directly proportional (ek barhe to doosra bhi usi hisab se barhe) hai. Yani temperature barhe to particles ki speed bhi barhti hai.
